n1.text:
Motion & sound
• Islands drift up/down slowly (6–9 s loops), each out of sync
• Fireflies rise and fade; stars twinkle
• Lumi bobs, blinks, and looks toward the island you tap
• Tapping an island zooms in with parallax (3D tilt)
• XP bar shimmer sweeps every few seconds

n2.text:
Motion & sound
• Tick = orb fills with light, sparkle burst, +10 XP floats up
• Sound: tick-1 → tick-5 rising bells, ringing into each other
• Finished quests drift down and dim
• Block complete → block-complete chime + Lumi spin

n3.text:
Motion & sound
• Screen dims, crest rises from below with a glow bloom
• Particles rain upward, crest rotates slowly in 3D
• Sound: level-up.mp3, then reward.mp3 when the chest opens
• Vibration: long celebratory pattern

n4.text:
Motion & sound
• Crystals on the mountain light up one per completed exercise
• Personal best → crystal flares + 'New record' chip
• Week dots glow when a session is done
• Level progress ring fills on each session

n5.text:
Motion & sound
• Days fill in like lanterns lighting up, one by one, when the month opens
• Tap a day: it lifts and shows that day's quests, habits and XP
• Level-up and reward days sparkle
• Swipe between months; the journey strip glows week by week
